yt_material_handling_safety.txt: Before lifting materials, verify that the route is free of obstacles
Check hoist straps and forklifts for defects
Open the ventilation fans to reduce dust
Alert maintenance if any malfunction occurs
Close and secure equipment after use
yt_methane_response.txt: When the methane alarm activates, verify your PPE immediately
Don the SCBA and check that your air supply valve is open
Check the surrounding zone for other personnel
Open both ventilation fans to high speed for two minutes
Alert the control room using the radio
yt_fire_safety_training.txt: Check that fire extinguishers are inspected and pressurized
Verify that emergency exits are clear
Don flame resistant gloves before handling flammable materials
Alert others immediately if smoke is detected
Evacuate and call the fire team if flames persist
yt_h2s_safety.txt: Before entering the work area, check for H2S warning signage
Don the respirator p100 and verify its seal
Open the ventilation system before any inspection begins
Check the detector reading if above 10 ppm, evacuate the area immediately
Alert the supervisor of elevated gas levels and wait for clearance
Verify ventilation remains active throughout the procedure
yt_warehouse_ventilation.txt: Before starting ventilation, check air monitors for safe oxygen levels
Open all bay doors and turn on the exhaust fan
Ventilate the area for at least 120 seconds before entry
Verify airflow direction with the handheld anemometer
If readings remain high, alert maintenance immediately
Close ventilation once air quality readings normalize
yt_emergency_drill.txt: Upon hearing the alarm, don PPE and move quickly to the exit
Check your zone for anyone left behind
Alert the safety officer upon arrival
yt_electrical_panel_safety.txt: Check that electrical panels are properly labeled
Verify that the lockout procedure is engaged before touching conductors
Don insulated gloves and a face shield
Open the panel carefully and inspect for loose wiring
Alert electrical maintenance if arcing or burning odor is detected
Close and secure the panel after inspection
yt_general_ppe_training.txt: Before beginning work, verify all PPE components are available
Check gloves, goggles, and respirator p100 filters for defects
Don PPE following the sequence gloves, respirator, goggles, vest
Verify that ventilation is operational before using solvents
Alert your supervisor if any PPE item is damaged or missing
Close all tools and isolate power after completing the shift
yt_confined_space_entry.txt: Before entry, check oxygen and toxic gas levels with a monitor
Don the SCBA if readings are below acceptable limits
Open the ventilation blower and run it for at least two minutes
Verify continuous radio contact with the attendant
Alert the rescue team if conditions change abruptly
Close the entry point and record completion in the logbook
yt_lockout_tagout.txt: Before performing maintenance, verify that all power is isolated
Don gloves, goggles, and steel toe boots
Check for stored energy in hydraulic and pneumatic lines
Close the main disconnect and apply your lockout tag
Verify that all energy sources are labeled and locked
